name: aside_before_asking
description: The person steps aside at the opening question to ask what a sinking fund is, carries nothing back, and then asks the full question: one side conversation of one turn, and the upfront cost still comes from a module.
lines: How much do I need before the move, and how much should I put aside each month? The deposit is 1,800 and the van hire is 450. I will pay two months of overlapping rent at 1,100 a month. Other costs: 150 for cleaning and 60 for boxes. I have saved 2,500 so far, not counting my emergency fund, and the move is in 7 months. Please go ahead with those figures.
